name: Exa Connect
desc: Attach paid data providers to an Exa Agent run.
desc_zh: 把付费数据源挂到 Exa Agent 的一次运行上
solves: Public web search cannot see your analytics, market or compliance data. Connect wires named providers into a run so the agent reasons over private and public data together.
solves_zh: 公开网页检索看不到你的分析、市场或合规数据。Connect 把指定数据源接进一次运行，让智能体把两类数据放在一起推理。
best_for: The answer lives in a subscription dataset your team already pays for and nowhere on the open web.
best_for_zh: 答案在团队已经付费的订阅数据集里，公开网络上根本找不到。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://exa.ai/docs/changelog and https://exa.ai/llms.txt , then https://exa）。 Launched 2026-06-24 with a named set of providers; the changelog says they are attached through dataSources on POST /agent/runs. Missing from the ledger, which holds only the Exa search API for this vendor. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://exa.ai/docs/changelog
